name: Labor Insurance (勞工保險)
authority: 勞工保險條例第13條、第15條第1款與勞工保險投保薪資分級表 — an 11.5% ordinary-risk premium borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government; the insured-salary grade table IS the band ladder below. Employment insurance is collected on the same ladder as the separate EI scheme, and the two together are the 12.5% combined premium the Bureau of Labor Insurance publishes.

name: Employment Insurance (就業保險)
authority: 就業保險法第8條、第40條與勞工保險條例第15條第1款 — a 1% employment-insurance premium on the same 投保薪資 ladder, borne 20% by the insured, 70% by the insured unit and 10% by the central government. 就業保險法第5條 limits cover to insured persons aged 15 to 65 who hold ROC nationality (or are a qualifying foreign spouse of a national), which is the age selector and the band predicate below.

name: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)
authority: 全民健康保險法第18條、第27條第1款第2目與第29條，與全民健康保險投保金額分級表 — a 5.17% premium borne 30% by the insured, 60% by the insured unit and 10% by the government; the insured unit's amount is multiplied by 1 + 平均眷口數 (0.56 since 2024-01-01), so the employer leg below is 5.17% × 60% × 1.56.

name: Labor Pension (勞工退休金, new system)
authority: 勞工退休金條例第14條第1項 — the employer shall contribute monthly to the worker's individual pension account no less than 6% of the worker's 月提繳工資, graded by the 勞工退休金月提繳分級表 (ceiling NT$150,000). The grade table IS the band ladder below.

name: Occupational Accident Insurance (勞工職業災害保險)
authority: 勞工職業災害保險及保護法第16條與第19條第1項 — the premium is 行業別災害費率 plus a single 0.07% commuting-accident rate and is borne wholly by the insured unit. Rates are the 勞工職業災害保險適用行業別及費率表 (勞動部 113-11-07 勞動保三字第1130085419號公告, in force 2025-01-01, next revision 2028-01-01); the band class is that table's 費率編號 1–55.

name: Individual Income Tax withholding, resident 5% election (薪資所得扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法第88條與各類所得扣繳率標準第2條第1項 — for a resident the payer withholds either by the 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 or, at the taxpayer's election, 5% of the full month's payment; this scheme carries the 5% election. 各類所得扣繳率標準第13條: no withholding where the amount to be withheld does not exceed NT$2,000, which is the MIN_WITHHOLD rule below.

name: Individual Income Tax withholding, non-resident (非居住者薪資扣繳)
authority: 所得稅法第88條與各類所得扣繳率標準第3條第2款 — 18% of the payment to a non-resident, reduced to 6% where the full month's salary does not exceed 1.5× the Executive-Yuan-approved basic wage (NT$42,885 for this version). 各類所得扣繳率標準第13條's NT$2,000 floor does not apply to a non-resident.
